shortDescription: Fetches a checksum of a GitHub project and returns it.

options.name: architecture
options.description: Target architecture used to filter the checksums. Valid values correspond to common system architectures.

options.name: cache
options.description: Validity of cached metadata in minutes. Prevents unnecessary repeated GitHub API calls.

options.name: checksum_file
options.description: The name of the checksum file to fetch from the GitHub release assets.

options.name: password
options.description: Optional GitHub personal access token or password. Used to avoid rate limiting or access private repositories.

options.name: project
options.description: Defines the GitHub project (organization or user). Example: **prometheus**/alertmanager → project = prometheus

options.name: repository
options.description: Defines the repository name within the given project. Example: prometheus/**alertmanager** → repository = alertmanager

options.name: system
options.description: Target operating system used to filter the checksums.

options.name: version
options.description: GitHub release version (tag) to look up. Must match an existing release tag in the repository.
